text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Aranesp overdosage can cause hemoglobin levels above the desired level, which should be managed with discontinuation or reduction of Aranesp dosage and/or with phlebotomy, as clinically indicated [see Pharmacodynamics ( 12.2 )] . Cases of severe hypertension have been observed following overdose with ESAs [see Warnings and Precautions ( 5.4 )].
